Trigger You cast a spell with a cast time of 3 actions or fewer from the Diviner class using a spell slot, or your focus points.

In the moment that you touch upon fate’s tapestry, you gather the potential of the different futures and pool them into another card. You @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.9Tbqe5G8pdrrOUfT]{Draw Card} and you can hold an additional card until the end of your next turn.

Special If you are at least trained in Occultism or Fortune Telling Lore or a similar lore skill, you can use Peer Fortune by successfully taking an action and making a @Check[fortune-telling-lore|dc:@self.level] skill check against a Normal DC (if using Lore) or a Hard DC @Check[occultism|dc:@self.level|adjustment:2] (if using Occultism) for your level.
